direction_notes: Both LIFU and rTMS groups improved on FMA and MBI with no between-group difference post-intervention; change-from-baseline FMA gains were larger with LIFU; prefrontal fALFF increased in the LIFU group.
safety_notes: Vital signs monitored before and after each session; no stimulation-related adverse events were observed in either group.
